nesnd_jp_foreign_reason.zh: 日本与大陆的关系，长久由援兵、朝贡和海上买卖维系。丰臣借这些关系平定诸侯，列岛上的政权也因此受到外朝的干预。如今各国都在寻找新的财源与盟友，自主、改革和统一的要求将随着使者渡海而去；对方是否愿意让步，仍取决于它自己的利益。
nesnd_jp_foreign_reason.en: Military assistance, tribute and maritime trade have long bound Japan to the mainland. These ties helped the Toyotomi overcome their rivals and gave foreign governments a hand in Japanese affairs. Governments now seek new sources of wealth and new partners. Envoys will carry requests for autonomy, reform and union, which their counterparts will judge according to their own interests.

nesnd_jp_korea_reason.zh: 丰臣与吴国的联军征服朝鲜南部之后，煤矿、港口与驻军把两岸的利益紧紧联在一起。朝鲜地方居民希望掌握自己的民政和税赋，列岛的统治者则长期倚赖半岛的资源与航路。地方治理与领土归属，将决定这些旧有关系怎样延续。
nesnd_jp_korea_reason.en: After Toyotomi and Wu forces conquered southern Korea, mines, ports and garrisons bound interests on both sides of the strait. Local Koreans seek control over civil affairs and taxation, while Japanese governments have long relied on the peninsula’s resources and shipping routes. Questions of local government and sovereignty will shape the future of these ties.

nesnd_jp_envoy_away.zh: 使者正在等待对方的答复。
nesnd_jp_envoy_away.en: Our envoy is awaiting a reply.

nesnd_jp_envoy_rest.zh: 使团尚未整顿完毕；两次遣使须相隔 #v 6#! 个月。
nesnd_jp_envoy_rest.en: The delegation is not yet ready to depart again. Envoys may be sent once every #v 6#! months.

nesnd_jp_subject_treaties.zh: 本国仍受宗主约束，可以就自主权与建设寻求交涉。两次遣使须相隔 #v 6#! 个月。
nesnd_jp_subject_treaties.en: The country remains subject to an overlord and may negotiate over autonomy and development. Envoys may be sent once every #v 6#! months.

nesnd_jp_independent_treaties.zh: 本国可以自行寻求外援与合邦。两次遣使须相隔 #v 6#! 个月。
nesnd_jp_independent_treaties.en: The country may seek foreign assistance and union on its own behalf. Envoys may be sent once every #v 6#! months.

nesnd_jp_korea_across_the_strait.zh: 朝鲜的领土争议仍待交涉。
nesnd_jp_korea_across_the_strait.en: Territorial questions in Korea remain open to negotiation.

nesnd_jp_korea_governors_status.zh: 朝鲜属地的税务与民政由总督集中处理。
nesnd_jp_korea_governors_status.en: Governors direct taxation and civil administration in our Korean territories.

nesnd_jp_korea_councils_status.zh: 当地议事会参与民政与教育。
nesnd_jp_korea_councils_status.en: Local councils take part in civil administration and education.

nesnd_jp_korea_undecided.zh: 政府尚未确定朝鲜属地的治理办法。
nesnd_jp_korea_undecided.en: The government has yet to settle how its Korean territories will be administered.

nesnd_jp_seek_autonomy_desc.zh:
请求宗主放宽对本国的约束，将现有宗属关系提升一个自治等级。

若获同意，双方将有 #v 5#! 年停战期。
nesnd_jp_seek_autonomy_desc.en:
Ask the overlord to relax its control and raise our subject relationship by one autonomy level.

Acceptance will establish a #v 5#!-year truce between the two countries.

nesnd_jp_seek_independence_desc.zh:
要求宗主解除藩属关系，让本国自行处理内外事务。

若获同意，双方将有 #v 5#! 年停战期。
nesnd_jp_seek_independence_desc.en:
Ask the overlord to end the subject relationship and recognize our right to govern our own affairs.

Acceptance will establish a #v 5#!-year truce between the two countries.

nesnd_jp_seek_reform_permission_desc.zh: 请宗主认可本国的制度改革，让我们能够自行筹划官员任用、军政与议政的安排。
nesnd_jp_seek_reform_permission_desc.en: Seek the overlord’s assent to domestic reform, allowing us to reconsider appointments, military administration and political representation.

nesnd_jp_seek_union_permission_desc.zh: 请宗主允许我们同其他日本属国商议归并，由愿意合邦的双方共同结束分立。
nesnd_jp_seek_union_permission_desc.en: Ask the overlord to permit negotiations with other Japanese subjects over a voluntary union.

nesnd_jp_seek_overlord_capital.en: Seek Development Funds from the Overlord

nesnd_jp_seek_overlord_capital_desc.zh:
请求宗主拨款兴办工场、培养熟练工匠，使本国的生产能够成长。

获准后，#v 3#! 年内不能再次获得这项资助。
nesnd_jp_seek_overlord_capital_desc.en:
Ask the overlord to fund workshops and the training of skilled workers, giving domestic production room to grow.

After receiving assistance, further funding is unavailable for #v 3#! years.

nesnd_jp_seek_capital_cne_desc.zh:
以工商业合作为纽带，向北朝争取建设资金，吸引其参与日本的发展。

获准后，#v 3#! 年内不能再次获得这项资助。
nesnd_jp_seek_capital_cne_desc.en:
Seek development funds from the northern government, offering closer commercial ties as a reason to support our growing industries.

After receiving assistance, further funding is unavailable for #v 3#! years.

nesnd_jp_seek_capital_hus_desc.zh:
以通商和工业发展为由，向东洲争取一笔用于工场建设的资金。

获准后，#v 3#! 年内不能再次获得这项资助。
nesnd_jp_seek_capital_hus_desc.en:
Approach Dongzhou for funds to build workshops, making the case for closer trade and industrial development.

After receiving assistance, further funding is unavailable for #v 3#! years.

nesnd_jp_seek_capital_usm_desc.zh:
南朝与日本的商业联系由来已久。我们可以循着这些关系寻求资助，为本国工场筹集资本、培养工匠。

获准后，#v 3#! 年内不能再次获得这项资助。
nesnd_jp_seek_capital_usm_desc.en:
The southern government has long-standing commercial ties with Japan. Draw on these connections to seek funds for workshops and the training of skilled labour.

After receiving assistance, further funding is unavailable for #v 3#! years.

nesnd_jp_independence_play_desc.zh: 向宗主提出独立的最后通牒，发起独立[concept_diplomatic_play]，准备以战争迫使其接受。
nesnd_jp_independence_play_desc.en: Issue an ultimatum for independence, opening an independence [concept_diplomatic_play] and preparing to enforce the demand through war.

nesnd_jp_union_jap_desc.zh: 向$JAP$提出合邦。对方若同意，其国家将并入本国，由我们的政府统辖。
nesnd_jp_union_jap_desc.en: Propose a union to $JAP$. If accepted, their country will be annexed into ours and governed by our state.

nesnd_jp_union_jtk_desc.zh: 向$JTK$提出合邦。对方若同意，其国家将并入本国，由我们的政府统辖。
nesnd_jp_union_jtk_desc.en: Propose a union to $JTK$. If accepted, their country will be annexed into ours and governed by our state.

nesnd_jp_union_jim_desc.zh: 向$JIM$提出合邦。对方若同意，其国家将并入本国，由我们的政府统辖。
nesnd_jp_union_jim_desc.en: Propose a union to $JIM$. If accepted, their country will be annexed into ours and governed by our state.

nesnd_jp_korean_governor_desc.zh:
任用总督，将朝鲜属地的税务与民政集中起来，使政府能够更直接地掌握当地的收入与事务。

此后 #v 24#! 个月内不能改换朝鲜治理方针。
nesnd_jp_korean_governor_desc.en:
Appoint governors to centralize taxation and civil administration in our Korean territories, giving the government closer control over local revenue and affairs.

Korean policy cannot be changed again for #v 24#! months.

nesnd_jp_korean_councils_desc.zh:
让当地议事会参与民政、兴办学校，以地方人士的合作缓和居民对统治的抵触。

此后 #v 24#! 个月内不能改换朝鲜治理方针。
nesnd_jp_korean_councils_desc.en:
Bring local councils into civil administration and education, seeking local cooperation to ease resistance to our rule.

Korean policy cannot be changed again for #v 24#! months.

nesnd_jp_korean_envoy_desc.zh:
向朝鲜或其宗主提出和解。对方若同意，我们将把本国在釜山与两湖的领土移交朝鲜，并放弃对这两个地区的宣称。

两次遣使须相隔 #v 6#! 个月。
nesnd_jp_korean_envoy_desc.en:
Offer a settlement to Korea or its overlord. If accepted, our holdings in Busan and Yangho will pass to Korea, and we will relinquish our claims to both regions.

Envoys may be sent once every #v 6#! months.

nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d1.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]希望扩大自行处理国事的权力，要求我们放宽现有宗属关系的约束。使者认为，更大的自主可以让地方政府及时应对国内事务，同时保留两国之间的联系。
nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d1.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] seeks greater authority over its own affairs and asks us to relax the present subject relationship. The envoy argues that greater autonomy would let the local government respond to domestic needs while preserving ties between our countries.

nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d2.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]的使者要求结束藩属关系。他们希望从此自行决定外交、军队与通商事务，并以独立国家的身份同我们往来。这份答复将决定我们是否愿意交出原有的宗主权。
nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d2.en: An envoy from [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] asks us to end the subject relationship. Their government seeks control over diplomacy, the military and trade, and wishes to deal with us as an independent country. We must decide whether to relinquish our authority as overlord.

nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d3.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]希望改造国内的官员任用、军政与议政制度。使者前来寻求我们的认可，以便政府能够召集支持者、推行新政。原有的宗属关系仍将保留。
nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d3.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] wishes to reform appointments, military administration and political representation. Its envoy seeks our assent so that the government can rally supporters and pursue its programme. The existing subject relationship would remain in place.

nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d4.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]正为工场建设寻求一笔资金。使者希望我们拨款，帮助他们扩建生产、培养熟练工匠，以日益兴盛的工商业加深双方的往来。
nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d4.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] is seeking funds for workshop construction. Its envoy asks us for a grant to expand production and train skilled workers, arguing that growing industry would deepen ties between our countries.

nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d5.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]提出就朝鲜南部的领土问题达成和解。他们愿意放弃对釜山与两湖的宣称，并将本国仍持有的当地领土移交朝鲜。使者要求我们接受这一安排，结束这项长期争端。
nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d5.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] proposes a settlement over southern Korea. Its government offers to relinquish claims to Busan and Yangho and transfer any territory it still holds there to Korea. The envoy asks us to accept these terms and settle the dispute.

nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d6.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]邀请我们结束两国分立，由他们的政府统辖双方的疆土、军队与国事。这意味着我们的国家将并入[SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]，不再保有单独的政府。决定权仍在我们手中。
nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d6.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] invites us to end the division between our countries and place both territories and their affairs under its government. Acceptance would annex our country into [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] and end our separate government. The decision is ours to make.

nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d7.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]希望得到我们的许可，同其他日本属国商议归并。他们打算由本国政府主持统一，并承诺只有受邀国家同意才结束其单独统治。我们需要决定是否允许这项合邦计划在现有宗属体系内进行。
nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d7.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] seeks our permission to negotiate union with other Japanese subjects. Its government would lead the union, with each invited country surrendering its separate government only by consent. We must decide whether to allow such negotiations within the existing subject order.

nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting]的使者已经抵达，带来了有关两国关系的提议。他们正在等待我们的答复。
nesnd_jp_foreign.1.d.en: An envoy from [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_sender').GetNameNoFormatting] has arrived with a proposal concerning relations between our countries and awaits our reply.

nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d.zh: 使者带回了[SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting]的答复。对方已经接受我们的提议，双方将依照商定的安排处理此事。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d.en: Our envoy has returned with the reply from [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting]. They have accepted our proposal, and the agreed arrangements will govern the matter.

nesnd_jp_foreign.3.d.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting]拒绝了使者带去的条件。我们未能说服对方让步，这次交涉也使两国的关系更为紧张。
nesnd_jp_foreign.3.d.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting] has rejected the terms carried by our envoy. We failed to persuade them to concede, and the exchange has strained relations between our countries.

gov_nesnd_japan_lin_regency_desc.zh: 保留天皇名位，由摄政王代行统治、主持政务的君主制政权。
gov_nesnd_japan_lin_regency_desc.en: A monarchy in which a Prince-Regent conducts the government on behalf of the imperial sovereign.
